explanation.headline: FDA lists liraglutide injection as a current shortage first posted 2023-07-18; no public FDA signal at our plants

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows liraglutide injection as Current with an initial posting date of 2023-07-18 and an update on 2026-10-14.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 39 months.
The shortage is listed for Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., Meitheal Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Novo Nordisk, Inc., and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. (To Be Discontinued).
Teva's related information states discontinuation of the manufacture of the drug.
The rule-selected option is to buy from Biocon Pharma Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.

rejected.text: Novo Nordisk's related information states the product will be available until discontinuation in January 2027.
rejected.reason: month 2027-01 is not in the cited evidence

rejected.text: No public FDA signal exists at our plants.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
